data.narrative: The student successfully audited the security profile of the codebase, identifying and fixing a critical role escalation vulnerability on the team members endpoint. They established comprehensive input validations and implemented a rigorous 13-constraint security test matrix, achieving 100% pass rate across the test suite.

dimension_scores.evidence: Defined specialized subagents like the 'WebSocket Feature Implementer' with clean interface contracts.

dimension_scores.observation: Conducted a detailed security audit identifying multiple critical and high security findings including privilege escalation and missing input validation.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced strict validation schemas first-pass to minimize iterations and compiled test code directly targeting all roles.
